{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("Sample of revenue column:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 20):")
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:20])

# Check if there are any non-numeric strings
print("\nAre there any non-numeric strings in revenue?")
non_numeric = sales['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^\d,\.]', na=False)
print(sales[non_numeric]['revenue'].unique())

# Identify and count the QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue == '999999.99'):")
print(len(qa_orders))"}
